apiToken.description: An API token from `POST /v2/tokens` (`at_live_...`), or a project's secret key (`sk_...`) for server-side ingest.

session.name: __Secure-ra.session_token
session.description: The admin session cookie set by GitHub sign-in at `/v2/auth`. The browser sends it on its own.

projectKey.name: X-Project-Key
projectKey.description: A project's public key (`pk_...`) for browser ingest, from an allowed origin; `?key=` works too.

cronSecret.description: The `CRON_SECRET` the scheduled jobs workflow sends.

WireEvent.description: One event. Each event in a batch is validated on its own.

id.description: A UUID the sender generates. A repeated id is counted as a duplicate and not stored again, so retries are safe.

name.description: The event name: a built-in such as `pageview`, `click` or `error`, or your own custom name.

ts.description: When the event happened, by the sender's clock. Ingest shifts it by the gap between `sentAt` and the time the batch arrived, so a wrong clock does not misplace it.

visitor.description: An anonymous visitor id the sender keeps. The browser SDK stores a random id in `localStorage`; no cookies are used.

session.description: A session id. The browser SDK keeps it in `sessionStorage` and starts a new one after 30 minutes without events.

page.description: The page the event happened on.

path.description: The page path without the query string, such as `/blog/hello`. Hash routes send the path after `#`.

route.description: The route template when the framework adapter knows it, such as `/blog/[slug]`.

referrer.description: The referring URL. The browser SDK only sends it on the first pageview.

props.description: At most 25 flat props with keys up to 255 characters. String values are up to 255 characters, except `stack` and `breadcrumbs` on `error` events, which are up to 2048.

context.description: Facts about the browser and visit. Every field is optional.

screen.description: Screen size in CSS pixels, as `WIDTHxHEIGHT`.

viewport.description: Window size in CSS pixels, as `WIDTHxHEIGHT`.

connection.description: The browser's effective connection type, such as `4g`.

utm.description: The `utm_*` query parameters on the page URL, without the `utm_` prefix.

release.description: Your app's release or version, used to group errors by release.

ua.description: The visitor's user agent, for server-side events. Only read on requests with the secret key; otherwise the request's own header is used.

ip.description: The visitor's IP address, for server-side events. Only read on requests with the secret key. It is hashed and looked up for location, never stored.

groups.description: The groups the visitor joined, such as `{ "company": "acme" }`: up to 5, keyed by a lowercase group type, with ids up to 128 characters. Reads filter and break down by `group:<type>`.

signals.description: Bot hints the browser SDK collected, as bit flags: `1` webdriver, `2` headless, `4` no input on a page that was never visible. Leave it out from servers.

ApiError.description: The error envelope every failed request answers with.

code.description:
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (400): Body, query or path fails the schema; details lists each field.
- `UNAUTHORIZED` (401): No or invalid session, token or key.
- `AUTH_REQUIRED` (401): The widget bootstrap was called without a signed-in session cookie.
- `FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN` (403): The public key was used from an origin that is not in the project's allowed origins.
- `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` (403): The widget bootstrap's Origin is not in any project's allowed origins.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): The token scope or the signed-in member's role does not allow the action.
- `WIDGET_REPORTS_DISABLED` (403): SDK client reports were sent to a project whose widgetReports switch is off.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Unknown route, project, visitor or session, or a private project without access.
- `CONFLICT` (409): A project with this id already exists.
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` (413): The ingest body is over 60 KB or has more than 50 events, or a client report body is over 16 KB.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429): The per-IP-hash limit was hit; wait for the Retry-After header.
- `INTERNAL` (500): Unexpected failure; the message never includes internals.
- `UNAVAILABLE` (503): The database is unreachable, or a feature the route needs is not configured: a job's store, alerts, CRUX_API_KEY, SMTP or Resend; ingest clients retry.

message.description: What went wrong, for people. Never includes internals.

details.description: Extra context for some codes: `fields` with each failed `path` and `message` for `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `retryAfterSeconds` for `RATE_LIMITED`.

docs.description: Link to this error code in the API reference.
